summary: FT-033 rev 3: adversarial bounds on the rev-2 metrics-bound title/author/date layout, plus exact identity regressions. Validated GlyphMetrics::advance_width/em values as finite and non-negative before they reach layout arithmetic (new TitleLayoutError::InvalidGlyphMetric/InvalidEmMetric); a NaN width previously compared false against every page-fit `>` check and could have silently produced a NaN baseline. Added TitleLayoutError::InvalidPageArea, checked once against sheet.page_layout().text_area before the existing BlockTallerThanPage comparison, reachable via Stylesheet::with_geometry (oversized margin or explicit zero/negative textwidth/textheight), not a hand-crafted internal state. tests/adversarial.rs (17 tests): enormous title (500k chars), 5000 authors, whitespace-only author line, mid-string None, non-finite/negative glyph and em metrics, degenerate page area, combining marks and zero-width text -- every case a typed error or a bounded Ok, never a panic or hang. tests/exact_identity.rs (3 tests): literal exact-equality pins (assert_eq!, no epsilon) of computed row font sizes, baselines, total heights, and horizontal extents for representative 10pt/12pt inputs. Consumer check: grep -rln 'flashtex_title_layout|flashtex-title-layout' crates outside crates/title-layout finds nothing -- no consumer exists yet; adapter contract documented in coordination/daniel-title.md rather than inventing one. cargo test: 46 tests + 1 doctest, all pass. cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean. cargo fmt --check: clean.
next_action: Await Commander integration; no consumer wiring in this revision. A future consumer implementing GlyphMetrics must only return None or a finite, non-negative Pt.
